("form_drafts"."template_id" IS NOT NULL AND "form_drafts"."observation_cycle_id" IS NULL)

subjects_grades_min_le_max_check.name: subjects_grades_min_le_max_check

resources_has_source_check.name: resources_has_source_check
resources_has_source_check.value: "resources"."file_key" IS NOT NULL OR "resources"."external_url" IS NOT NULL

video_submissions_ready_requires_hls_che.name: video_submissions_ready_requires_hls_check
